questions.title: Confirm the proposed test seams and failure paths?
questions.text: S1: model setup and effective rendered selection, including missing/failed/partial inventory, unresolved inheritance, installed-vs-default mismatch, later rejection and changed setup. S2: task generation/execution/resume with real red-to-green commit, interruption, completed units and legacy/ambiguous pairs. S3: scope confirmation/analyze with undeclared seams, omitted git-failure injection, stale/missing acceptance, scope changes and valid exemptions. S4: deadline handoff/accounting with near-deadline boundary, optional repeat omitted, in-flight overshoot, pending checks, resumed independent verification and stall enforcement. Use synthetic inputs, temporary repos and existing renderer/state CLI seams. Full definitions in plan.md Test seams.

questions.title: Which model policy should the factory preserve?
questions.text: Shipped adapters currently pin models for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode; Claude Code standard is haiku. DESIGN/README and tests still expect only Claude Code pins and sonnet. The focused baseline ran 19 tests with three policy failures and no errors.
